Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS

1. Performance Guarantee - Successful Bidder shall have to submit 5% of Performance Guarantee of Co ntract value as per instructions given in General Conditions of Contract (GCC) for Services-2018 issued by Railway Board. 2. (a) The vehicle should be Commercial Tax Paid vehicle and have proper authority to run on roads at any places as per requirement. (b) The tenderer(s) must submit registration number of the vehicle along with the year of manufacture or a dvance booking receipt of new vehicle at time of submission of tender. Further, for registered vehicles, the tenderer(s) must submit the relevant documents i.e. Ownership/Road permit/Road Taxes/Comprehensive I nsurance along with staff travelling with vehicle/Pollution under Control and Driver License Certificates etc. with the offer. Bidder not having a vehicle at the time of bidding can also bid subjec t to submission of a Notarized Affidavit as per format attached as Annexure- E. In case of non- submission of above said credentials, offer will be summarily rejected. (c) Vehicle should be registered either in the name of the firm or in the name of the proprietor/partner of t he firm. (d) The original documents may be asked from eligible tenderer(s) for verification by Railway before award ing the contract. (e) Bidders must upload/submit annexure A, B, C & D after due fulfillment and signature as per instructi ons given in annexures; otherwise offers will be summarily rejected. 3. (a) Rate shall be quoted on ‘Per month’ basis and the rate will be inclusive of all taxes, license fee, toll p laza fee, parking charges, wages of Driver, repairs and maintenance cost, Fuel, Lubricants etc. complete in all respect. The vehicle should have FASTag and connected with Bank account having sufficient amount so that vehicle may pass toll booth without any problem. (b) Railway shall not be responsible for any escalation in price viz. Diesel or any other items etc. what –so- ever or any increase in any duties, levies or taxes in respect here of what so ever and the contract rates a nd obligations shall remain unaffected by such escalations or increase during the contract period. 4. This tender is for hiring of road vehicle (SUV) for 2500 KM/Month, Outstation, 24x7. It is acknowledged th at driver may be required in night- shift also in case of urgent requirement of Railway, during accidents, de railments, breakdowns, night inspection, any urgent requirement of Railways etc. The firm will ensure that driver worked in day-shift should not be deputed in night – shift, whenever called by Railway in case of urg ent requirement, to avoid any human error accident with vehicle. 5. Number of Kilometers the Car hired is 2500 KMs per month with cumulative 30000 KMs per year. The ve hicle hired will be utilized for official duties of AEN/TMC/PD/DDU at DDU or movement to any other place in East Central Railway along with adjacent locations of East Central Railway of East Central Railways as per i nstruction of AEN/TMC/PD/DDU. In any month, running of vehicle can be more than or less than the scale o f 2500 Kms/month but the cumulative distance per year shall not exceed 30000 KMs. Payment will be mad e on monthly basis as per accepted monthly rate irrespective of actual KMs run in that month. 6. (a) The vehicle should be mechanically sound and shall be well maintained with neat and clean interiors /exteriors, proper cushioning with back rest, Towels etc. The driver should display good behavior and be dr essed neatly in white uniform. Smoking and use of Mobile phone during driving by driver is strictly prohibit ed. In case of any deficiencies pointed out by the user, the contractor will rectify/remove the deficiencies a t his own cost within 48 Hours otherwise, a penalty as mentioned in foregoing para 13 (c) for each occasio n shall be imposed on contractor. (b) The vehicles offered should not be older than 2022 year make. The vehicle shall comply the latest emis sion standards.

7. Hired vehicle should be equipped with prescribed emergency medical kit and a fire extinguisher as per s tatutory provisions. Vehicle must possess sufficient fuel while reporting on duty. 8. Contractor shall be fully responsible for any repair, accident, loss, damage to the vehicle and driver. If a ny fine or penalty is imposed by various authorities such as RTA, Traffic Police etc. for any violation such a s speed, traffic rules violation etc, the same will have to be borne by the contractor only. 9. (a) The driver should normally be able to read & write in Hindi/English and should be in possession of valid driving license. Drivers of vehicle should be courteous, polite and posses the valid driving license and clean police record. No accommodation to drivers and garage facility for vehicles will be provided by Railw ays. The driver will make his own arrangements for breakfast, lunch, dinner, tea etc, while on duty. Driver shall not leave his duty unless permitted to do so by personal authorized by AEN/TMC/PD/DDU. (b) Driver deployed should not have criminal background. The contractor will also submit Police Verificatio n Certificate along with local address of the deployed Driver. (c) The driver deployed should be of sound mind and health and are not suffering from any infectious & co ntagious disease. Medical certificate should be submitted from a registered medical practitioner. (d) The contractor should issue identity card which will be endorsed by SSE/JE/TMC for authenticity but, this I card shall not be used as an authority to travel in train service. (e) The contractor shall provide a suitable and reliable mobile phone with SIM Card in working condition to driver at his own cost, throughout the currency of contract. Mobile number should be furnished to Controlli ng official/PD/DDU. If the vehicle’s driver is not responding to phone calls or any other mode of communica tion, disobeying orders of administration, a penalty as mentioned in foregoing para 13 (c) for each occasio n shall be imposed on the contractor. (f)Speedometer of the vehicle provided is to be sealed and shall be in working conditions at all the times. T he driver of the vehicle shall maintain a log book in which day to day movement of the vehicle is to be not ed. Entries of journey shall be authenticated by AEN/TMC/PD/DDU or his authorized representative. 10. The payment shall be made by the Railways on Monthly basis on submission of bill and log book duly checked & certified by SSE/TMC or as nominated by Dy. CE/TMC/PD/DDU. The bill on monthly basis shall b e uploaded on GEM portal and attested copies of log book and certificates should be submitted in hard cop y. Kilometers logged from the tenderer premises to office/residence of AEN/TMC/PD/DDU and back to tend erers premises shall not be payable under the hiring arrangement. 11. Recovery of Income Tax and Other Tax: a) Income Tax @ 2% (Two percent) on the Gross amount of each bill, with a surcharge of 15% (Fifteen perc ent) on the Income Tax deducted, will be recovered from all the bills of the contractors in terms of Section- 194 (C) of Income Tax Act-1961 and Ministry of Finance circular No. 593 dtd. 05.02.1991. In case of any re vision / alteration in taxes, received from the Income Tax Department, the same will be taken into account as per the directives. b) Railway will deduct TDS @2% on IGST transaction as per RBA No.- 97/2018 and RBA No. 100/2018, GST circular no. 35/2018 c) Any other taxes (if any) will be recovered from the contractors’ bills as per the rule, circulated by the co ncerned state Government 12. In case of accidents/Mishap etc. the full responsibility and all consequences thereof, shall lie with the c ontractor only. The Railways shall pay no compensation whatsoever in this regard. Any litigation or any la w-and-order problems arising due to irregularity or accidents shall be the total responsibility of the contrac tor supplying the vehicle. The Railway shall not bear any responsibility and the Railway will not pay any co

mpensation. 13. (a) In case, the vehicle is not made available under this contract for duty on any given day due to any reason, a suitable alternate vehicle will have to be provided by the contractor. In case of delay/failure, con tractor shall be responsible to pay a penalty as mentioned in foregoing para 13 (c) in addition to deductio n of payment for number of days vehicle not provided on pro-rata basis. (b) If the vehicle goes out of order or under break-down for whatsoever reason, the contractor shall provid e an alternative arrangement within one hour. If contractor fails to provide alternate vehicle, a similar type of vehicle will be hired by Railway which rental charges will be borne by the contractor in addition to a pe nalty as mentioned in foregoing para13 (c). (c) Penalty Clause for Non- Compliance:- (i) Unwashed seat cover - Rs. 100/- per day (ii) Any deficiencies in vehicle pointed out by the user and not rectified/removed within 48 Hours - Rs.500/- per incident (iii) For Disobedience of Driver - Rs.500/- per incident (ii) Non availability of sufficient fuel – Rs. 1000/- per incident (iii) Breakdown of Vehicle – Rs. 2000/- per incident (iv) Vehicle not provided – Rs. 4000/- per day. 14. No advance payment shall be made to the tenderer. The payment however, shall be made to tenderer as early as possible on the receipt of bills duly checked and verified by SSE/TMC or as nominated by Dy. C E/TMC/PD/DDU after a reasonable time as per departmental rules. The tenderer shall not claim any interest on the delayed payment. 15. As far as possible, contractor should provide a fixed vehicle and fixed driver. The performance of driver and the vehicle should be up to the satisfaction of the user. 16. The tenderer shall fulfill all obligations under various labor laws in force regarding deployment of contr act workers in respect of services provided under this tender. 17. It is mandatory for the contractor to upload/update Labour data on Railway’s Shramik Kaly an Portal as has been elaborated below: A. Contractor is to abide by the provisions of Payment of Wages act & Minimum Wages Act in term s of chapter 6 of General Conditions of Contract for Services 2018. In order to ensure the same, an applicat ion has been developed and hosted on website https://shramikkalyan.indianrailways.gov.in. Contractor sh all register his firm /company etc. and upload requisite details of labour and their payment in this portal. T hese details shall be available in public domain. The Registration/updation of portal shall be done as under : (a) Contractor shall apply one-time registration of his company/firm etc. in the Shramik Kalyan Portal with requisite details subsequent to issue of Letter of Acceptance. Railway Engineer shall approve t he contractor's registration on the portal within 7 days of receipt of such request. (b) Contractor once approved by any Engineer, can create password with login ID (PAN No.) for subsequen t use of portal for all LOAs issued in his favour. (c) The contractor once registered on the portal, shall provide details of his Letter of Acceptances (L

oA)/ Contract Agreements on Shramik Kalyan Portal within 15 days of issue of any LoA for approval o f concerned engineer. Engineer shall update (if required) and approve the details of LOA filled by c ontractor within 7 days of receipt of such request. (d) After approval of LoA by Engineer, contractor shall fill the salient details of contract labours engaged i n the contract and ensure updating of each wage payment detail on Shramik Kalyan portal on monthl y basis. (e) It shall be mandatory upon the contractor to ensure correct and prompt uploading of all salien t details of engaged contractual labour & payments made thereof after each wage period. B. While processing payment of any ‘On Account bill' or ‘Final bill' or release of ‘Advances or Perfo rmance Guarantee/Security deposit', contractor shall submit a certificate to the Engineer or Enginee r's representatives that I have uploaded the correct details of contract labours engaged in connect ion with this contract and payments made to them during the wage period in Railway's Shramik kalyan p ortal at ‘www. shramikkalyan.indianrailways.gov.in' till Month Year.” (Railway Board's letter No.2018/CE-I/ CT/4 dated 17.10.2018). 18. The performance of the contractor shall be monitored and the contract may be terminated at any time for poor performance by giving seven days and 48 hrs. notices as per clauses of GCC. 19. The contractor at his own cost shall arrange the reliever for the Driver for over time as well as weekly r est etc. 20. The vehicle will be equipped with tool box and spare tyre in good condition filed with air. 21. As per the requirement, the vehicle may go outstation involving nights/days stay. No separate paymen t for such stay will be given.
